caseName: Abernathy v. Eastern Air Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: ABERNATHY Et Al. v. EASTERN AIR LINES, INC., Et Al.
attorneys: Whiteford S. Blakeney for appellants in No. 450. Wade W. Mitchem for appellants in No. 451., William D. Holoman for appellee Employment Security Commission of North Carolina.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeals are dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeals were taken as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
